text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The day of the Kikuka Sho.
Zenno Rob Roy waited for race time
with an intensely focused demeanor.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Since the winner of a race is the one who runs the fastest,
there is no doubt that what a racer must prioritize above all else
is, undeniably, "speed.")

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Naturally, fighting through a grueling 3,000-meter race
requires plenty of 'stamina.' However...)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Even if one attains both 'speed' and 'stamina'
through daily training—)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (It definitely won't be enough to win the 'Kikuka Sho'.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(From the Junior Class up until this moment in the Classic Class,
there are no races as long as 3,000 meters.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Every Umamusume challenges this for the first time here.
The final leg of the Classic Triple Crown where champions gather,
on a stage granted only once in a lifetime.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (Overcoming two hills, enduring a glare that felt like eternity, subjected to an unimaginable level of exhaustion.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (Only above the head of the one who overcomes it all and races across the Yodo turf faster than anyone else—)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (The crown of chrysanthemums shines bright.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(So the last thing I need is surely... "heart."
Unrivaled "speed," peerless "stamina," and...)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(An unwavering will, at all times.
An unbreakable conviction, honed like a blade.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Which is why the victor of the Kikuka Sho
is hailed as the "strongest"—!!)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I want to gain it.
I must gain it, no matter what... Here, I will find strength!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: So that I can compete against Kris S in the next Arima Kinen...!!
choice_data_list: With feelings that strong, you'll be fine.
With feelings that strong, everything will be okay.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(My 'feelings'—my 'heart.'
Yes, the me right now can do it...!!)
choice_data_list: Go on ahead, Zenno Rob Roy!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Yes!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaah...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Towards the turf echoing with cheers,
Zenno Rob Roy steps forward with a dignified...
and powerful stride.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Aiming to become the "Strongest Umamusume"—
The curtain rises on the battle now!
